473:t_1:4.en:
$$静子$$
「...So $$つばさ$$ has returned to $$くろがね屋$$?」

473:t_1:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yes... Though the staff are joining $c, so $$くろがね屋$$ itself will remain closed.」

473:t_1:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Mom will live with $$シロー$$ and $$ローレライ$$, and stay with Dad there while he recuperates.」

473:t_1:7.en:
$$静子$$
「You've been through a lot, $$甲児$$.」

473:t_1:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Mom asked me to tell you she's sorry for worrying you too, Mrs. $$明神$$.」

473:t_1:9.en:
$$ナミダ$$
「I hope your dad gets better, $$甲児$$...」

473:t_1:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks to you too, $$ナミダ$$. When you get some time, go visit $$シロー$$.」

473:t_1:11.en:
$$アンディ$$
「...What I don't get is what that bastard $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is thinking.」

473:t_1:12.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Watch your mouth, $$アンディ$$. We haven't decided that he's our enemy yet.」

473:t_1:13.en:
$$アンディ$$
「W-What, $$ＭＩＸ$$?! You're still taking his side?!」

473:t_1:14.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「...It's not that, but I just can't believe he's a bad person...」

473:t_1:15.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... I know how you feel.」

473:t_1:16.en:
$$メール$$
「Deep down, I still can't bring myself to hate $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ either...」

473:t_1:17.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Could he... be trying to train us...?」

473:t_1:18.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You mean he's deliberately playing the enemy?」

473:t_1:19.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's possible. Though I have no idea why he'd go out of his way to do that.」

473:t_1:20.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「That really might be right...」

473:t_1:21.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Yes. Even what happened to $$甲児$$ could be interpreted as an attempt to draw out $$マジンガー$$'s true power.」

473:t_1:22.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「But that put $$甲児$$ in danger, and $$竜馬$$ ended up unconscious because of it.」

473:t_1:23.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Even for a Spartan training regimen, that's going too far.」

473:t_1:24.en:
$$カイエン$$
「And the way he called $n his property rubs me the wrong way.」

473:t_1:26.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You've been quiet this whole time, $$アマタ$$. What do you think?」

473:t_1:27.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Oh... Yeah... I was thinking $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is kind of like Supreme Commander $$不動$$...」

473:t_1:28.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I was thinking the same thing...」

473:t_1:29.en:
$$シュレード$$
「He appears out of nowhere and gives precise advice, but never lets us lean on him...」

473:t_1:30.en:
$$カグラ$$
「He ain't that impressive! Old man $$不動$$ just treats us like pets!」

473:t_1:31.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm with $$カグラ$$. Seems old man $$不動$$ is like that, no matter what era he's in!」

473:t_1:32.en:
$$ジン$$
「...That's what the wild ones think. How about you?」

473:t_1:33.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$ can be harsh, but everything he did was for our sake...」

473:t_1:34.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Like $$チコ$$ said, maybe $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ really does care about us too...」

473:t_1:38.en:
$$メール$$
「Oh... Yeah... I just thought it was unusual for Darling to pray to a god...」

473:t_1:41.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Is something wrong with that?」

473:t_1:42.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've never been too fond of turning to gods only when you're in trouble...」

473:t_1:43.en:
$$メール$$
「Yeah. So when you suddenly said you were praying, it surprised me.」

473:t_1:44.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's no good... We've been in one pinch after another lately. Maybe I'm losing my nerve somewhere inside.」

473:t_1:46.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Are you thinking about that man, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

473:t_1:47.en:
$n
「I think there's no point trying to figure him out.」

473:t_1:48.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then what are you thinking about?」

473:t_1:50.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Do you still like her?」

473:t_1:52.en:
$n
「But... It's a fact that $$マキ#pilot$$ helped me when I was having a hard time emotionally.」

473:t_1:53.en:
$n
「Even if $$マキ#pilot$$ approached me on a mission for $$クロノ$$, I won't forget that.」

473:t_1:54.en:
$$甲児$$
「...When $$ジン$$ was killed by $$ミカゲ$$...」

473:t_1:55.en:
$n
「Yeah... With Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s special training and Miss $$スズネ$$'s help too, I managed to pull myself out of despair.」

473:t_1:56.en:
$$甲児$$
「...Like $$ランド$$ said, right now I feel like praying to anything, god or devil.」

473:t_1:58.en:
$$甲児$$
「His external wounds are one thing, but apparently he's suffered brain damage.」

473:t_1:59.en:
$n
「Don't blame yourself, $$甲児$$. $$竜馬$$ got hurt because all of us made mistakes.」

473:t_1:60.en:
$$甲児$$
「...I know that in my head, but I can't come to terms with it that easily...」

473:t_1:61.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$竜馬$$'s like a big brother to me.」

473:t_1:67.en:
$$ランド$$
「Calm down. Take your time and tell us what happened.」

473:t_1:73.en:
$$渓$$
「What the hell are you planning to do, $$號$$?!」

473:t_1:74.en:
$$號$$
「I'll expose $$竜馬$$ to the $$ゲッター線$$ collected by $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$.」

473:t_1:75.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You're gonna hit him with a $$ゲッター$$ Beam?!」

473:t_1:76.en:
$$號$$
「They will not be that highly concentrated.」

473:t_1:77.en:
$$號$$
「But $$ゲッター線$$ stimulate the life force of living creatures.」

473:t_1:78.en:
$$隼人$$
「You're planning to heal $$竜馬$$ with the power of $$ゲッター線$$...」

473:t_1:79.en:
$$渓$$
「Stop him, $$隼人$$! I've never heard of anything like this!」
